_readme: This is Subject 13, the A/L General English subject sat in Grades 12
and 13. It is NOT Subject 73 (A/L English Literature), and it is NOT
the practical/adult English that now lives at practical-english/.
The section is deliberately small. The Drive audit found 10 provincial
papers pending source verification, 1 marking scheme, no model papers
and no syllabus document. Rather than pad the section out, the pages
say plainly what is being prepared.
The redirect pages below preserve the old general-english/* addresses,
which held practical English content before the split. GitHub Pages
cannot issue a 301, so each emits a canonical tag, a meta refresh and a
visible link. They are excluded from the sitemap and the search index.

blocks.title: Three different things called English
text: **General English (Subject 13)** is the A/L subject on this page, sat by students in Grades 12 and 13 alongside their main subjects.
**English Literature (Subject 73)** is a different A/L subject, with its own prescribed texts. It is in [A/L Literature](al-literature/).
**Practical English** is not an examination subject at all. It is everyday, spoken and workplace English for adults and independent learners, and it is in [Practical English](practical-english/).

blocks.heading: What this section will hold
text: General English is assessed in two papers. The work is language rather than literature: grammar and vocabulary in use, reading comprehension, and writing for a purpose.
This section is being built from provincial and zonal papers whose sources are being verified before anything is published.

blocks.title: What is still missing
text: The papers above are provincial and zonal papers whose issuing body was confirmed by reading the document itself, not its filename. Every one of them had an inaccurate filename.
**Still to come:** the official Department of Examinations General English papers, model papers, and a written guide to the examination structure. More resources coming soon.
